title: Deep Learning-Based Sitting Posture Recognition from Pressure Distribution Across Hard and Soft Seat Environment
content: This study investigates the classification of nine sitting postures using pressure distribution data from hard and soft seat surfaces. Three neural network architectures (FNN, CNN, ResNet) were evaluated under single-surface and mixed-domain training regimes. While all models achieved high accuracy (>96%) when trained on mixed-domain dataset, significant performance degradation occurred in cross-domain testing. CNN demonstrated superior capability in leveraging spatial pressure features under mixed training conditions, while FNN exhibited relatively better cross-domain robustness. Results indicate model performance highly depends on architectural inductive biases and training data diversity. These findings underscore the importance of employing representative multi-surface datasets for ensuring generalization in practical sitting posture recognition systems.
